'''Mehmet Alovar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] from [[Coral City/Legends|Coral City]] who was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the Mon Calamari aristocracy. In his later [[Standard year/Legends|years]], he was a highly respected individual among members of his [[Species/Legends|species]] and was one of his people's emissaries to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. However, the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] viewed him to be a bigoted and short-sighted individual. During the [[Dac Peace Conference]] held by the Alliance to reconcile differences between the Mon Calamari and Quarren at some point following their [[Calamarian Revolt|revolt]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Alovar attempted to bring about a peaceful outcome, although he also stood fast in protecting the interests of his people.<ref name="InTooDeep" />
